biography: Sennan Fielding's journey began not on a meticulously groomed track, but on the rain-slicked backroads of his family's farm in rural England. His father, a weekend rally enthusiast, introduced him to the thrill of speed early, letting young Sennan wrestle with the steering wheel of a beat-up Land Rover on muddy fields. This unconventional training instilled in him a unique car control, a talent he honed in local karting championships before transitioning to single-seaters. A defining moment came at Brands Hatch in his Formula Ford days; battling for the lead in the final corner, Sennan executed a daring overtake, scraping the barriers but clinching victory. This aggressive, yet calculated move caught the eye of Audi's junior program, leading to his current role as a reliable, if not spectacular, member of their GT racing squad. Now at 37, Fielding is considered a steady hand within the team, often tasked with bringing the car home safely rather than chasing outright wins.
drivingStyle: Fielding is a primarily defensive driver, known for his exceptional consistency and tire management. He rarely pushes for the absolute fastest lap, instead focusing on maintaining a consistent pace and capitalizing on the mistakes of others. His corner entry is cautious, prioritizing stability and exit speed over aggressive braking. While not the flashiest driver on the grid, his ability to consistently deliver solid results makes him a valuable asset in endurance races.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from a controversial collision in a Formula 3 race years ago. Bellini has always accused Fielding of deliberately blocking him, a claim Fielding vehemently denies.

Dubois, known for her aggressive overtaking style, has often clashed with Fielding on the track. Their contrasting approaches to racing have led to several heated on-track battles and post-race arguments.
Tanaka and Fielding were teammates early in their careers and maintained a simmering competitive tension as their careers progressed.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, regardless of the weather.
Listens to classical music before every race to calm his nerves.
Refuses to eat any food that is orange in colour on race day.
famousQuote: Racing isn't always about being the fastest; it's about being the smartest.
careerHighlight: Winning the Spa 24 Hours with Audi in 2021, contributing crucial consistent laps during a chaotic race.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final hour of the Nürburgring 24 Hours in 2019 due to a mechanical failure, costing his team a likely victory.
